transition_definitions.establishment: first checkpoint with full-support R<0.1, center accuracy>0.9, and layer-6 linear accuracy>0.9
transition_definitions.onset: first probe checkpoint with full-support R<0.9 and layer-6 linear accuracy>0.5, with both conditions retained at the next probe checkpoint
transition_definitions.ordered_trend_test: exact blocked Page-style permutation test over within-seed onset-ordinal ranks; no onset by 10M receives the terminal ordinal after 10M
